applicable_when: xnumel=9 but XBLOCK=128 means 119 of 128 threads per CTA are masked out on every load/store — a 93% waste of thread slots in the X dimension. This causes: (1) only 18/32 bytes utilized per L1 sector (uncoalesced), (2) 41.5% idle issue slots, (3) only 0.91 waves/SM so the GPU is never fully saturated. The fix is to right-size XBLOCK to match xnumel (use XBLOCK=16) and increase YBLOCK to compensate, boosting the grid's CTA count and improving memory coalescing on the Y dimension stores.
